lanting.note: Wang Xizhi’s own sheet is lost. This tracing, made at the Tang court, is the copy closest to his hand; it keeps even his corrections. Hover to look closely at the brushwork.
lanting.credit: Feng Chengsu after Wang Xizhi. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

fuchun.note: Huang Gongwang painted it over three or four years, into his eighties. In 1650 a dying collector had it thrown on the fire; his nephew pulled it out in two pieces. The longer one, shown here, is in Taipei; the shorter, Remaining Mountain, is in Hangzhou.
fuchun.credit: National Palace Museum, Taipei. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
